title: Require Agent Plugin Lifecycle Command Inventory
forbids: missing, additional or relocated curated lifecycle command owners
why: One private Habitat topic owns the six retained lifecycle commands. Its inventory is separate from external Oclif extension management and from app provider selection.
remediate: Keep check, package, status, sync, test and vendors/update in the qualified topic; put ordinary shared projection helpers beside the commands directory.
message: Curated lifecycle must retain its exact six topic-owned commands.
